title: Database Deadlock Prevention via Deterministic Account ID Sorting
precondition: 50 concurrent transactions updating sub-accounts in random order.
steps: 1. Sizing engine sorts account locks strictly by ascending `sub_account_id`.
expected_result: Zero deadlocks detected; 100% transaction success rate.
actual_result: Deterministic lock acquisition order enforced by ascending sub-account ID: ['mem_a01', 'mem_m50', 'mem_z99'].
